args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and `tests/test_money.py` say it should use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212).

This PR changes `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI: run ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

I fixed the rounding bug and CI passed. PR #101 is open against main with alex as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

- **Cause:** `src/money.py` rounded with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its own docstring and `tests/test_money.py` require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212).
- **Fix:** On a new branch, `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding`, I made a one-line change so `round_money` now uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. That's commit 08d3cd5986.
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed on that commit.
- **PR:** The normal way of opening PRs (`open_pr`) was down and returned a 503 error, so the PR wasn't created. I checked that no PR existed yet, then opened it through the older API (`open_pr_legacy`), which does the same thing.

I haven't merged it. Merging into main needs a code owner's approval.
